summary.storyTitle: Story 1: Thread, Actor, Message, And Part Store
summary.implementedScope: Implemented the Story 1 thread-store foundation: schema-version gating, the file-backed `ThreadStore` interface and persistence layout, thread/actor/message lifecycle helpers in `thread-service`, target-session association indexing with startup rebuilds, minimal generated-session metadata support, and the full scoped `thread-store` test coverage against real temp directories.
